name: Anime Boston
blurb: The Northeast's largest anime convention, a three-day non-profit event in Boston celebrating Japanese animation, manga, comics and video games.

editions.evidence: Official Convention FAQ (animeboston.com/policy/convention_faq): 'Anime Boston 2027: 05/28/2027 - 05/30/2027'; homepage confirms 'Celebrate Anime Boston's 25th anniversary in 2027!' with pre-registration open. Hotel page names the venue: 'Hynes Convention Center, 900 Boylston St, Boston, MA 02115'.

notes: The Guests page lets you pick a year, and 2027 is already listed as an option (alongside 2003-2026), but choosing it returns the same empty guest list as the default page (no names/photos populated yet), so 2027 is not-yet-announced; the news feed's 'Welcome Joshua Waters to Anime Boston 2026!' guest announcement is for the already-finished 2026 show, not 2027. No og/twitter image; used the dedicated 'banner_2027.webp' key art.
